arabesque: Arabic pop to timeless tarab. From Amr Diab, Sherine and Nancy Ajram to Saint Levant and DYSTINCT, winding down with Majida El Roumi, Fairuz and Warda. Genre: Arabic pop, Khaleeji, tarab, nasheed.
french vibes: Parisian nights, afro-French bounce. Aya Nakamura, Tiakola, Dadju, Tayc, Stromae and Joé Dwèt Filé. Genre: French pop, afro-pop, French rap.
café parisien: A slow coffee on a Paris terrace. Charles Trenet, Édith Piaf, Joe Dassin, Zaz, Indila and Christine and the Queens. Genre: chanson, French classics, soft pop.
in my feels: Rap for the overthinking hours. Juice WRLD, NF, Mac Miller, Drake, Post Malone and Polo G. Genre: melodic rap, emo rap, conscious hip-hop.
pre-workout: No warm-up needed. Travis Scott, Future, Lil Uzi Vert, Playboi Carti, Metro Boomin and Kendrick Lamar. Genre: trap, hype rap, hip-hop.
rap throwbacks: The rap you grew up on. Eminem, Lil Wayne, Kanye, Wiz Khalifa, Snoop Dogg and Macklemore. Genre: 2000s and early 2010s hip-hop.
pop on repeat: The pop you can't skip. Dua Lipa, Charlie Puth, Justin Bieber, Rihanna, Doja Cat and Sia. Genre: modern pop, dance-pop.
throwback pop: Aux cord, 2012. Katy Perry, One Direction, Pitbull, Jason Derulo, Selena Gomez and Taio Cruz. Genre: 2000s and 2010s pop.
3am thoughts: For when you can't sleep. Ali Gatie, Lauv, Lewis Capaldi, Billie Eilish, Teddy Swims and James Arthur. Genre: sad pop, ballads, acoustic.
festival mode: Main stage energy. Avicii, Marshmello, The Chainsmokers, Kygo, David Guetta and Calvin Harris. Genre: EDM, house, dance.
stadium anthems: Arms up, sing it back. Coldplay, Imagine Dragons, OneRepublic, AJR, Twenty One Pilots and Bastille. Genre: pop-rock, alt-pop.
indie sunsets: Golden hour with the windows down. Dominic Fike, Rex Orange County, Tame Impala, beabadoobee, TV Girl and Steve Lacy. Genre: indie, bedroom pop, alt.
lofi study: Soft instrumental beats, no lyrics, just focus. Nujabes, Jinsang, Idealism, Kupla, Tomppabeats and WYS. Genre: lofi hip-hop, chillhop, instrumental.
Underwater: Everything slowed down and drifting. slō, twilight, Shiloh Dynasty, untrusted and Powfu. Genre: slowed + reverb, sad lofi, bedroom pop.
bollywood nights: Filmi hits and Punjabi bangers. Pritam, Arijit Singh, Vishal-Shekhar, Shreya Ghoshal and AP Dhillon. Genre: Bollywood, Punjabi, desi pop.
reggaetón: Perreo all night. Bad Bunny, J Balvin, Ozuna, Daddy Yankee, Shakira and Rauw Alejandro. Genre: reggaeton, Latin trap, Latin pop.
afrobeats: Lagos to London. Burna Boy, Wizkid, Rema, CKay, Tems, OMAH LAY and Asake. Genre: Afrobeats, afropop, amapiano.
afro house: Warm drums and deep grooves. Ginton, Trinix, Craig Isto, June Freedom, Naïka and Black Coffee. Genre: afro house, afro-fusion, deep house.
uk rap: Straight from the ends. Dave, Central Cee, AJ Tracey, T MULLA, J Hus and Stormzy. Genre: UK rap, drill, grime.
late night r&b: Lights low, volume up. Khalid, The Weeknd, Brent Faiyaz, SZA, Daniel Caesar and GIVĒON. Genre: R&B, neo-soul, alt-R&B.
golden oldies: Songs that never get old. ABBA, Michael Jackson, Queen, The Beach Boys, Fleetwood Mac and Bonnie Tyler. Genre: classic rock, disco, soul, oldies.
back roads: Dirt roads and open skies. Noah Kahan, Zach Bryan, Lord Huron, The Lumineers, Vance Joy and Hozier. Genre: folk, country, Americana.
smoky jazz bar: Dim lights in a 1940s jazz bar. Laufey, Frank Sinatra, Ella Fitzgerald, Etta James and Michael Bublé. Genre: jazz, swing, vintage, crooners.
island time: Sun out, worries off. Bob Marley, Shaggy, UB40, Damian Marley, Sean Paul and Koffee. Genre: reggae, dancehall.
pop punk: Loud, fast, forever 17. Green Day, Paramore, Fall Out Boy, Panic! At The Disco, blink-182 and All Time Low. Genre: pop-punk, emo, alt-rock.
